messages:
sarah: quick alignment — i'm drafting the v1 exit checklist we promised legal/pm. need owners for dashboard copy, telemetry queries, and the console flag flow. TL;DR: we want a low-friction sunset that gives tenants opt-in runway and clear billing signals.

omar: +1. can you list the exact telemetry slices we need? i can add the SQL and wire into the alerting dashboard. :thumbsup:

sarah: initial thought: 1) active v1 tokens by tenant 2) 7/30/90 day call volume delta (v1 vs v2) 3) error-rate spike post-switch 4) quota-attr anomalies (double-counting) 5) banner impressions -> clickthrough to migration docs. need examples for each.

marta: for billing teams: also include per-tenant token-weighted cost delta when routed to fallback variants. that'll surface surprise overages.

omar: putting a stub SQL for the 7/30/90 split — can someone sanity-check and own it in metrics?
```sql
SELECT tenant_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= now() - interval '7 days' THEN tokens END) as tokens_7d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= now() - interval '30 days' THEN tokens END) as tokens_30d,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ts >= now() - interval '90 days' THEN tokens END) as tokens_90d
FROM api_usage
WHERE api_version = 'v1'
GROUP BY tenant_id;
```

alex: looks fine. we'll need to join on routing_event to attribute cases where console forced a fallback. otherwise numbers will undercount.

sarah: good catch — add `LEFT JOIN routing_events re ON re.request_id = api_usage.request_id` and include `re.fallback_reason`.

lia: for the console copy — propose two lines: (1) banner short: "v1 will be retired on <date>. Click to migrate." (2) modal copy when clicked: explain opt-in shadow mode, rollback, and expected billing delta estimate. keep short.

omar: recommend adding a small sample calc in the modal: "Estimated change in token cost: ~+/-X% based on your last 30 days." we can fetch X from the per-tenant cost-delta query.

sarah: owners: omar = telemetry queries + dashboard panels; lia = console copy + modal UX; marta = billing impact and pricing note; alex = routing-events instrumentation and runbook for fallback labeling; i'll own the exit checklist doc and coordinate legal/pm copy.

telemetry-bot: Scheduled check: will run the v1_usage_health query daily at 09:00 UTC and post results to #eng-platform-dash-insights.

omar: question on rollout: do we want a canary cohort where we show the banner but don't block, vs an aggressive forced pin-unpin? previous rollouts showed churn when we unpinned automatically.

marta: prefer phased: 1) banner + opt-in migration 2) shadow routing for 2 weeks (no billing change) 3) soft pin for tenants that opt-out and are inactive 4) final forced sunset with 30d warning.

alex: technical constraint: our current routing switchback code treats missing version header as v2. if we start showing banner on v1 clients that still send v1 headers but route them to v2 shadow, we must ensure quota attribution remains to the original tenant and not split incorrectly. otherwise billing team will see misattribution.

sarah: that's crucial. add to runbook: "verify quota attribution by request_id pre/post switch; test with synthetic tenant that sends mixed headers." alex can you add a test plan?

alex: yes — i'll create a small e2e that: send 1k v1 requests (pinned), 500 v1 requests routed to shadow v2, and assert tokens billed in both systems equal total. will push to ci.

lia: UX ask: dashboard should have a single toggle to "Preview migration impact" that runs the per-tenant cost-delta and shows a projected delta graph. does telemetry infra support on-demand queries?

omar: yes via ad-hoc panels, but we need rate-limit safeguards — don't let preview queries spin expensive aggregation across entire history. suggest sampling last 30 days or pre-aggregated monthly rolls.

sarah: put a blocker in the checklist: "preview API uses sampled 30d aggregates; telemetry team to approve query cost threshold."

marta: legal wants migration notice copy to include: data retention implications, and whether logs will be stored in the same place post-switch. also needs audit trail of when tenant clicked migrate. we should instrument that event.

alex: add event: `tenant_migration_intent` with properties {tenant_id, click_ts, current_version, target_version, estimated_cost_delta}. send to audit-log stream and to `routing_events` topic. i'll wire the Kafka schema.

sarah: perfect. assign alex to schema, omar to dashboard widget, lia to copy. marta will own billing acceptance criteria.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/banner-v1-exit (env: staging) — CI green.

lia: once banner is in staging, can we run a quick internal rollout to beta tenants? we have 3 customers willing to test migration flow.

omar: add a telemetry label `migration_beta=true` for those tenants so dashboards filter them. also add `sample_rate=1.0` for detailed logging for two weeks.

marta: payment ops: will coordinate notices and invoice previews for beta tenants. need an opt-out clause in modal.

alex: last note: instrument a `compatibility-regressions` alert that triggers if v1->v2 conversion increases 5xx rate by >1% absolute or latency p95 increases by >200ms for two consecutive hours. ties into incident runbook.

sarah: added to checklist. ok — next steps: i'll post a one-pager to #product-ops and attach the checklist. owners above will comment on the doc by EOD Thu. thanks all. :tada:
